subject: Vendor onboarding: legal name / TIN alignment and PO timing
messages:
From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmetech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding - initial tax docs and PO request

Hi Mina (and Monica),

Thanks for the quick onboarding checklist earlier. We are ready to get a PO in place so our implementation team can start the integration next month. Attached is our current W-9 (for AcmeTech, Inc.) and a short remit sheet. A few notes:

- Legal name on invoices: "AcmeTech, Inc."
- EIN (for payment routing): 12-3456789 (on W-9)
- Parent company is Acme Holdings Ltd. (foreign entity) — we can provide the parent's W-8BEN-E if that helps.

Questions:
1) Will Redwood require a bank letter or notarized EIN verification before issuing the PO?
2) Can you confirm if any ownership / UBO details are needed because the parent is foreign?

We can upload the attachments to your portal or send via DocuSign if you prefer.

Attachments: acmetech_w9.pdf (W-9), remit_instructions.pdf

Best,
Jordan Li
Procurement Lead | AcmeTech
jordan.li@acmetech.com
billing@acmetech.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - initial tax docs and PO request

Thanks Jordan — quick clarifying questions so procurement/legal can validate the file and move PO to PRE-ISSUE status.

Hi Monica, looping you in for payment/PO timing.

Jordan — a few asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the legal entity type (C-Corp / S-Corp / LLC taxed as corp)? We need that to validate the W-9 fields.
- If AcmeTech, Inc. is the invoicing entity but a foreign parent has >25% ownership, we require UBO declarations for any individual(s) >25% and the parent-level documentation (W-8BEN-E) for our tax records.
- For US-payees we generally accept a scanned W-9 plus a bank verification letter (bank letter confirming account name and last 4 routing digits). For foreign parent relationships we may also request an EIN verification (IRS CP 575 or bank letter referencing EIN) if the W-9 name/EIN show any mismatch.

If you prefer, upload the W-9 and ownership chart to the link below and reply here so we can route to legal faster: https://vendor.redwood.com/upload (or use your DocuSign link).

Estimated timing: once we have the W-9 and the ownership chart / bank letter, procurement can prepare a conditional PO in ~2 business days and move to full issuance after verification (~5 business days total typical).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0171

From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmetech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, billing@acmetech.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - initial tax docs and PO request

Mina — thanks, attached are the additional files you requested.

Attachments included: acmetech_w9_202703.pdf, acmetech_ownership_chart.xlsx, acmetech_w8bene_parent.pdf

Notes from our side:
- W-9 matches AcmeTech, Inc. — EIN 12-3456789.
- Ownership chart shows 40% held by Acme Holdings Ltd. (foreign). Remaining ownership is distributed across individuals (none >30%).
- We have a bank letter (scanned) but it references the DBAs and the parent in a single PDF. If you'd like we can obtain a separate bank letter that references the legal invoicing name exactly.

Can you tell me whether Redwood will issue a conditional PO with a payment hold flag while legal reviews the W-8 and bank letter? Our SOW kickoff is targeted for 2027-04-15, so having a PO in place (even conditional) would unblock the team.

Appreciate the help — let me know if the chart needs more granularity on natural-person UBOs.

Regards,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@acmetech.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - legal check and provisional PO

Jordan — Marissa from Procurement here. Looping in final notes after a quick legal check (summarized below).

Summary from Legal & Procurement:
- Legal reviewed the W-9 and W-8BEN-E you provided. Because the parent (Acme Holdings Ltd.) holds 40%, we need a short UBO attestation naming any individual natural persons owning >25% (per our KYC). Your ownership chart suggests no single natural person >25%, please confirm in writing.
- We will accept the W-9 you provided, but we need either:
  a) a clean bank letter that explicitly lists "AcmeTech, Inc." as the account owner, OR
  b) an IRS document/evidence that ties EIN 12-3456789 to AcmeTech, Inc. (CP 575 or equivalent).
- Procurement can issue a provisional PO (PO-1974-PROC) tomorrow with a payment hold flag and conditional-release terms. Payment release will follow verification (expected 3–5 business days after clean bank letter/UBO confirmation).

Next steps for AcmeTech (please reply-all):
1) Confirm in writing that no natural person owns >25% (or provide names if any do).
2) Provide a bank letter that names AcmeTech, Inc. exactly — if that requires an additional signed bank PDF we can accept it via the vendor portal or DocuSign.

If you prefer, we can still issue the provisional PO and note the payment hold in the SOW so your delivery team can begin onboarding. Confirm which you prefer and we'll proceed.

Thank you — looking forward to your confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
